output.dkeff: awk -v f=1 '/^##/{if($0~/PERTURBED SYSTEM NO/){match($0,/NO +[0-9]+/);s=substr($0,RSTART+3,RLENGTH-3)+0} else if(s>0 && $0~/LOWEST SIGMA ESTI\./){for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="+/-"){m[s]=$(i-1);d[s]=$(i+1)}; s=0} if($0~/TAYLOR SERIES EXPANSION/) t=1; if(t && $2~/^[0-9]+$/ && $4=="+/-"){m[$2]=$3;d[$2]=$5}} END{o=""; for(k=1;k in m;k++){v=(f==1?m[k]:d[k]); sub(/^\+/,"",v); o=o (o==""?"":", ") "\"" k "\": " v}; print "{" o "}"}' *.listing
